text.p: American John Kocinski consolidated his lead in the world superbike championship on Sunday with a first and second place in the two races at a rainy San Marino Grand Prix.
Former 500cc motorcycle world championship rider Kocinski, now riding for Honda, has 79 points after two races, ahead of Ducati-riding former superbike world champion Carl Fogarty of Britain on 65.

Italian Pierfrancesco Chili overcame the wet conditions to win the first race ahead of Kocinski but his hopes of a double in front of his home fans vanished when his Ducati had an electrical fault while leading the second race.
Fogarty kept in touch with two third places. The next grand prix is at Donington Park in England on May 4.
